method: All eleven original outlines have fixed source orientations: the nine orthogonal modes from the rejected witness and7-degree phases for both cogs. All22 translations remain variable. Exact outline partitions use two rectangles per bracket, one per insert and80 center-fan triangles per cog. Holes are filled for PIH-off separation. Every pair of pieces from different originals gets one separating axis selected once from the seed by maximum signed projection gap. A linear inequality requires at least0.225mm separation on that unit axis. Original outline bounds require0.025mm stock clearance. Feasible solutions therefore have sufficient original-outline clearance, subject to independent original-source validation.
objective: Minimize maximum absolute coordinate movement using one auxiliary variable, without fixing any active original.
limits: This fixes modes, cog phases and one axis branch per convex-piece pair. Infeasibility excludes only this frozen translation system, never the allocation or any other orientation/topology. This is a new independent construction method, not a retry of the closed necessary-model call. First55 remains mandatory but is not constructed here.
